PLAN 01 | THE WORLD FINDS A WORKER
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9
CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}}  {{CHAR_DOCK_WORKERS}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_PORT_PANORAMA}}  {{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}}
PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_MOORING_ROPE}}  {{PROP_NET}}  {{PROP_CARGO_HOIST}}
DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY
Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Cold neutral overcast daylight. Damp quay surfaces reflect the sky; restrained water bounce reaches the workers. Muted weathered materials, integrated port equipment and rounded masonry openings. The port is a living trading city within the referenced world, not a historical tourism illustration.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
The harbor is active. Jamshid is one worker among others on the working quay. A cargo crate hangs low in a sling beside a quay hoist. The water is beyond the quay edge; a clear loading zone separates workers from the suspended load.

PLAN 01 | SHOTS
SHOT 01-01 | 0s–5s | 5 SECONDS
12mm extreme wide from an elevated shore-side gallery. Hold a nearly fixed frame: ordinary merchant boats, cargo paths, working figures and water occupy separate depth layers. Discover activity without centering any person.
SHOT 01-02 | 5s–9s | 4 SECONDS
65mm close detail from waist height beside a worker: worn hands draw wet rope through a secure wrap around a fixed bollard. The rope slides under controlled tension. Frame hands and rough sleeve before revealing identity; this is Jamshid.
SHOT 01-03 | 9s–15s | 6 SECONDS
35mm medium from the landward side, rising only from hand height to chest height as Jamshid checks a net attachment. Reveal his referenced aged mask and stooped shoulders. He tests the fastening precisely, then follows the hoist rope with an alert glance. Another worker crosses the foreground; Jamshid stays off-center.
END STATE AND EDIT
Jamshid stands beside the hoist loading zone, aware of the working line. End on his glance toward the cargo mechanism, ready for its failure.
SOUND
Water against timber, wet rope friction, tools, foot traffic and distant nonverbal market bustle.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
